svg.aria-label: NanniSCII pipeline: from a consumer complaint to an image made of cuneiform signs
svg.title: NanniSCII pipeline: from a consumer complaint to an image made of cuneiform signs
svg.text: Six stages: how a consumer complaint becomes an image.
Redactions. Every XXXX survives as a break in the clay, and the image has empty cells at the same rate.
The seed. Same seed and settings, same complaints, same image.
The log. Every line keeps its Akkadian, its signs, a back-translation, and a confidence verdict.
